source_evidence: 11 Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 CHAPTER Local Government in Rural Areas The real India lives in its villages.
Let us now see how the government functions at the local level.
In this chapter, our focus will be on local government in rural areas; we will move to urban areas in the next chapter.
We have about 600,000 villages, 8,000 towns and over 4,000 cities.
